samples.heading: Heading
samples.label: Label
samples.statusChipsUsage: Info: open invoice. Success: paid invoice, ordered item. Error: sent invoice; “Overdue” once the payment term has passed.
samples.countBadgesUsage: Client cards of the side panel: worksheets, open invoices, sent invoices.
samples.otherChipsUsage: Number of problems or items (menu, transcript); active filter to remove.
samples.linesUsage: Lines of a worksheet and items of the shopping list. Planned exists on worksheets only: a click on the line plans it, a double click marks it done.
samples.vehicleTilesUsage: Client page: one card per vehicle. Checked: its worksheets and invoices are shown; the buttons open the registration document or a new worksheet.
samples.listRowsUsage: Client page: open worksheets and invoices of the client; a click opens it. Grey: paid invoice (same for the cards of the side panel: invoiced worksheet, paid invoice).
samples.sideCardsUsage: One item of the left panel (worksheet, invoice, client). Selected: the item shown, white with a strong border (even when done). Done: light grey.
samples.checkboxUsage: Several choices can be ticked: planned / done, options of a line.
samples.radioUsage: One choice in a group (size of a service, winter / summer…); clicking the chosen one clears it.
samples.segmentedUsage: One choice among a few, all visible: damage type, car / motorcycle, language EN / FR. The chosen option is dark.
samples.tabsUsage: Views of the same page (worksheet settings): the current one is underlined.
samples.comboboxUsage: Free text with suggestions (client, vehicle of a worksheet); the arrow shows them all.
samples.clearableUsage: The cross empties the field (search, kilometers…).
samples.hideableFieldUsage: Invoice: a note or the observations can be hidden (kept, not printed) or deleted.
samples.transcriptUsage: What was said (bubble), the answer with what it changed (click: shows the element), an answer that could not be applied (light red, to validate).
samples.userMessage: Service done on the Kia, 61 240 km.
samples.userMessage2: Add a parking brake check on the Fiat.
samples.problemMessage: No worksheet is open for a Fiat: nothing was changed.
samples.iconSource: All the icons come from Google Material Symbols (Outlined style), loaded from Google Fonts.
samples.iconRule: One size per use. Small: next to a text. Medium: alone in an icon button. Large: alone in a main (black) icon button. Extra large: the picture of the item.

panel.title: Tokens
panel.derived: Made from other tokens: change them instead

usage.color-background: Behind the elements: page, side panels, transcript days; also groups inside a card, chips, read-only fields and done items (invoiced worksheet, paid invoice).
usage.color-on-background: Text, icons and outlines everywhere; dark buttons, section titles of a worksheet, focus ring.
usage.color-on-background-soft: Secondary text (hints, dates, counts) and hover of dark buttons.
usage.color-on-background-faint: Placeholders, language code inside a field, empty values, clients not shown, damage legend marks.
usage.color-surface: Elements: cards, lines, panels, fields, dialogs. Text on dark and red buttons.
usage.color-neutral: Grey background: hover and selected item, notices (archived client, price to fill), scrollbar thumb; dividers inside an element.
usage.color-grid: Faint lines of the grid ruled on the work area, like a timing sheet (4% of the ink on the background).
usage.color-grid-cross: Small cross on each intersection of the grid (22% of the ink on the background).
usage.color-inverse: Dark areas: header (timing bar) and dropdown menus. Inside them the neutral colours are swapped.
usage.color-on-inverse: Text and icons on the dark areas; current page of the menu; text of the red badges.
usage.color-on-inverse-soft: Secondary text on the dark areas (titles of the menus).
usage.color-inverse-hover: Hover and selected item on the dark areas; squares of the liquid checkerboard of the header.
usage.color-info: Yellow flag: planned lines, open invoices.
usage.color-success: Green flag: done lines, paid invoices, ordered items.
usage.color-error: Red flag: transcript problems and notification badges, sent and overdue invoices, damage marks, delete buttons.
usage.color-info-bg: Background of planned lines and of the open status (40% of info: a clear tint of the yellow flag).
usage.color-info-line: Border of the open status and counts: the yellow itself.
usage.color-info-text: Text and icons of the open status and counts (40% of info, the rest ink: the yellow cannot be read as it is).
usage.color-success-bg: Background of done lines, ordered items and the paid status (28% of success: a clear tint of the green flag).
usage.color-success-line: Border of the paid status: the green itself.
usage.color-success-text: Text and icons of the paid status (55% of success, the rest ink: readable on its background).
usage.color-error-bg: Background of problems and of the sent status (24% of error: a clear tint of the red flag).
usage.color-error-line: Border of problems and of the sent status: the red itself.
usage.color-error-text: Text and icons of the sent status and counts (65% of error, the rest ink: readable on its background).
usage.font-heading: Titles and main menu: Archivo, wider and heavier, in capitals.
usage.font-width-heading: Width of the titles: Archivo goes from 62% (condensed) to 125% (expanded).
usage.font-size-heading: Page and panel titles, section titles of a worksheet.
usage.font-size-subheading: Titles of dialogs and of groups (vehicles, invoices…), days of the shopping list, tiles of this page.
usage.font-weight-strong: Emphasis: current choice, line titles, totals.
usage.font-tracking-label: Small spaced capitals: days of the transcript.
usage.line-height-single: Controls on one line: buttons, fields, chips.
usage.space-050: Inside chips and badges: the smallest gaps.
usage.space-100: Cannot be split: an icon and its text, a compact cell.
usage.space-200: Grouped elements: label and field, buttons of a row, items of a list; padding inside fields and buttons.
usage.space-400: Same area: padding of cards, panels, pages and dialogs; gap between the blocks of an area.
usage.space-800: Separate areas: sections of a page, columns of a layout, parts and padding of the invoice.
usage.radius-100: Small parts inside a control: checkbox, option of a switch or of a list, changed value.
usage.radius-200: Controls: fields, buttons, menu items, options of a switch, chat bubbles.
usage.radius-300: Containers: cards, lines, tiles, menus, dialogs, images, the invoice.
usage.radius-pill: Capsules: chips, badges, search fields, days of the transcript, scrollbar thumb.
usage.radius-circle: Real circles: radio buttons, company logo.
usage.corner-cut: Broken corners of the menus (pills of the pages, dropdown menus): length of the diagonal cut along each side.
usage.corner-cut-shape: Corners of every rounded element (fields, buttons, cards, lines, chips, dialogs): all four cut on the diagonal across their radius, with this shape (0: straight, 1: round; a little above 0: straight with soft folds, like the menu).
usage.stroke-border: Outline of every element and field.
usage.stroke-strong: Focus ring, selected card, active tab, element shown from a transcript change, resize handle, drop area (dashed).
usage.opacity-disabled: Disabled buttons and fields, checkboxes of done lines, hidden invoice text.
usage.overlay-backdrop: Behind a dialog, or an open panel on small screens.
usage.color-error-hover: Hover of the red buttons (delete confirmation).
usage.icon-size-small: Icon next to a text: text buttons, menus, fields, chips, badges, links.
usage.icon-size-medium: Icon alone in an icon button, or alone at the end of a row (arrow of a link row).
usage.icon-size-large: Icon alone in a main (black) icon button.
usage.icon-size-xlarge: Picture standing for the item: vehicle logo, client card, photo to add.
usage.field-button-size: Button inside a field (clear, hide, delete) and arrow of a list.
usage.grid-size: Squares of the grid ruled on the work area: large, a small cross on each intersection.
usage.grid-cross: Arms of the cross on each intersection of the grid, from its centre.
usage.dropdown-max-height: Long lists of choices scroll beyond this height (combobox, choices of a rule).
usage.panel-width: Width of an open side panel (left sidebar, transcript, tokens).
usage.panel-min-width: Narrowest width when a side panel is resized by dragging its edge.
usage.panel-max-width: Widest width when a side panel is resized by dragging its edge.
usage.z-raised: Above the next elements: head of a side panel over its list.
